units.NORMALIZED_CONTENT: tev++ is a small fork of tev whose local purpose is to make comparison/measurement lineage inspectable while remaining close to upstream tev.
The v0.1 source describes MeasurementSpec -> MeasurementStage -> ViewSpec with stage order Inputs -> Signed Difference -> Metric Output.

Show Upstream traverses existing representations backward and Resume traverses retained live lineage downstream without changing the measurement specification; source explicitly says this is return traversal, not reconstruction from a stored recipe.

The source states that interactive display/pixel inspection and materialized CPU statistics/export use different correspondence paths and tev++ records both rather than silently treating them as one operator.
Core source invariant: view state may change stage presentation but must not change what was measured or what the stage means.
The binary and rest of codebase are intentionally kept close to upstream tev; local delta is not presented as a replacement measurement engine.
MEASUREMENT_DEFAULT_RELATIVE_EPSILON is fixed at 0.01 for relative metrics to expose an existing upstream numerical assumption without changing v0.1 behavior.
MeasurementInputRef.runtimeId mirrors mutation-sensitive Image::id() for local disambiguation and is explicitly not a source revision or provenance identifier.
